name: Solar On Earth
old_description: A community solar program through Solar On Earth allows anyone (residential or commercial and regardless if you rent or own) to opt into a local community solar energy farm. The local solar farm allows you to take advantage of solar power without rooftop panels. You will help reduce emissions and lower your utility bill through solar credits.
about:
Solar On Earth is headquartered in Chelmsford, Massachusetts, with a secondary office in Chadwick, Illinois. The company operates a community solar program that enables residential and commercial customers to subscribe to local solar farms without installing rooftop panels. Founding year and ownership details are not publicly disclosed.

The firm administers community solar subscriptions across thirteen states, including Massachusetts, New York, Maryland, Maine, Hawaii, Illinois, Minnesota, Colorado, Vermont, Delaware, New Jersey, Rhode Island, and New Hampshire. It manages the enrollment process, provides ongoing subscriber support, and coordinates utility bill credits generated by the solar farms. The company does not disclose headcount, facility size, or transaction volumes.

Solar On Earth serves both residential and commercial customers regardless of whether they rent or own their property. Its programs are designed to help participants reduce emissions and lower utility bills through solar credits. The company highlights its work in states with aggressive renewable energy targets, such as Massachusetts’ goal of 100 percent renewable electricity by 2035 and New York’s mandate for 70 percent green energy by 2030.

The company emphasizes a hands-on approach, guiding new subscribers through every step of the process and offering ongoing support to ensure continued cost savings. It cites an A+ rating from the Better Business Bureau as a mark of service quality. The program was created to make solar power accessible without the need for rooftop installations.
